name: Go Hyeona
source:
CEO of a famous cafe known for delicious coffee, gorgeous desserts, and an extraordinary interior. She decided to join the show to promote her cafe.

Her elegant mood and calm personality stole every male cast's heart the moment she came to House of Crush. And there is something going on between Hazel and Christian...?

[From in-app]
